name: Thomas2Go @ BambooHR (Lindon, UT) Made-to-Order Roast Turkey & Swiss Panini
whyItWorks: Freshly sliced roasted turkey breast and naturally aged Swiss cheese pressed warm on sourdough bread with light olive oil or mayo. Warm, crispy, and easy on the gut.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Panini on sourdough bread with Swiss cheese; ask for mayo and hold raw red onions or mustard.
